nodes.description: Address of the contract creator, set from msg.sender in the AccessControl constructor and used by the onlyCREATOR modifier.
Boolean maintenance flag controlled by updateMaintenanceMode; gates the isContractActive modifier.
Address of the IAngelCardData contract used for angel lookups; settable by the creator via DataContacts.
Address of the IMedalData contract used to mint medals; settable by the creator via DataContacts.
Address of the ISponsoredLeaderboardData contract used to read and close leaderboards.
onlyCREATOR function that rewrites the three external contract addresses (angel, medal, leaderboard).
Public permissionless function that reads a leaderboard, validates it is closed and past its end time, then mints medals according to the prize tier.
Constructor that assigns creatorAddress = msg.sender.
onlyCREATOR function that grants seraphim privileges to an address.
onlyCREATOR function that revokes seraphim privileges from an address.
onlyCREATOR function that toggles isMaintenanceMode.
SafeMath helper returning a pseudo-random uint8 derived from block.blockhash(block.number-1) and an address.
Caller-supplied address used for ownership and privilege checks (creatorAddress, seraphims).
Timestamp value exposed as now and used in claimMedals to validate that the leaderboard end time has passed.
External call to sponsoredLeaderboardData.getLeaderboard and getTeamFromLeaderboard returning untrusted tuple data.
External state-changing call to sponsoredLeaderboardData.setMedalsClaimed on a creator-controlled contract address.
External call to angelCardData.getAngel returning the owner of each winning angel.
External call to medalData._createMedal that mints medals to the derived owners (potential reentrancy sink).
Faulty check 'if (medalsClaimed = true)' performing an assignment instead of a comparison, always evaluating truthy and reverting.
Leaderboard identifier supplied by the caller of claimMedals.
Local holding the leaderboard end time returned by getLeaderboard.
Local holding the leaderboard live flag returned by getLeaderboard.
Local holding the medals-claimed flag returned by getLeaderboard.
Local holding the leaderboard prize amount used to select the medal tier.

New medal data contract address accepted by DataContacts.
New sponsored leaderboard contract address accepted by DataContacts.
Owner of the ranking-0 angel, recipient of the top medal.
Owner of the ranking-1 angel, recipient of the second medal.
Owner of the ranking-2 angel, recipient of the third medal.
Owner of the ranking-3 angel, recipient of the fourth medal.
Temporary angel id reused while iterating over the leaderboard ranks.

edges.reason: AccessControl constructor assigns creatorAddress from the untrusted msg.sender value.
updateMaintenanceMode is gated by the onlyCREATOR modifier which compares msg.sender to creatorAddress.
DataContacts is gated by the onlyCREATOR modifier derived from msg.sender.
claimMedals compares now (block.timestamp) against the leaderboard endTime, making execution timestamp dependent.
claimMedals invokes the external getLeaderboard/getTeamFromLeaderboard calls.
claimMedals invokes the external setMedalsClaimed call.
claimMedals invokes the external getAngel calls to resolve winners.
claimMedals invokes the external _createMedal minting calls.
claimMedals executes the faulty medalsClaimed assignment check.
The leaderboardId parameter drives the logic of claimMedals.
The caller-supplied leaderboardId is passed into the external leaderboard lookup.
The caller-supplied leaderboardId is passed into setMedalsClaimed.
endTime is destructured from the untrusted getLeaderboard return data.
isLive is destructured from the untrusted getLeaderboard return data.
medalsClaimed flag is destructured from the untrusted getLeaderboard return data.
prize is destructured from the untrusted getLeaderboard return data.
The prize tier comparison branches select which medals are minted.
The defective medalsClaimed assignment check always reverts and controls the flow of claimMedals.
owner1 is assigned from the angel owner returned by getAngel.
owner2 is assigned from the angel owner returned by getAngel.
owner3 is assigned from the angel owner returned by getAngel.
owner4 is assigned from the angel owner returned by getAngel.
The per-rank angel id is taken from the untrusted getTeamFromLeaderboard return data.
The angel id local is passed as an argument to the external getAngel call.
owner1 is used as the recipient argument of _createMedal.
owner2 is used as the recipient argument of _createMedal.
owner3 is used as the recipient argument of _createMedal.
owner4 is used as the recipient argument of _createMedal.
The external _createMedal call can re-enter claimMedals before the claimed state is finalized, since the guarded flag check is defective.
DataContacts stores the supplied angel card data contract address.

DataContacts stores the supplied sponsored leaderboard contract address.

angelCardDataContract is the target address of the external getAngel calls.
medalDataContract is the target address of the external _createMedal calls.
